messages:
sam: Hey — following the Node quickstart (index.js + npm start) and my very first API call gets a 403. Response body is {"error":"workspace_tos_pending", "message":"Workspace terms must be accepted"}. I grabbed the API key from the invite email. No billing set up on the workspace yet. Has anyone seen this? :thinking:

maya: Ugh, yeah that specific error means the workspace itself hasn't been activated. Quick questions: are you using the workspace-scoped API key (the one you got in the invite) or an org-level key? Can you paste the exact curl you ran (redact the key)? :eyes:

sam: curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXREDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-redwood","prompt":"hi"}'

Response (redacted):
{
  "status": 403,
  "error": "workspace_tos_pending",
  "message": "Please accept workspace terms and activation in console to enable API access"
}

jordan: That matches what I've seen. When an admin invites a new member or creates a workspace, the workspace can be in a pending state until someone with admin rights accepts the workspace TOS/activation (and in some orgs, enables billing). Until that activation step, workspace-scoped keys are rejected with 403.

devex-bot: Docs: Quickstart & Workspace activation — https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart#workspace-activation. TL;DR: Log into Console -> Workspaces -> Select workspace -> Accept Terms / Activate. If you don't have admin permissions, ask your workspace admin.

maya: Workarounds: 1) Use a different workspace that's already active (if you have one). 2) Ask the admin to accept terms in Console. 3) If urgent, an org-level admin can create a short-lived org key for you (not ideal). We had a similar case where the invite flow omitted the final accept step for some orgs.

sam: Ah, that explains it. I was using the invite link to grab the key but didn't realize someone needed to accept the workspace TOS. I pinged our team admin to accept. Thanks! :pray:

support-bot: If your admin accepted and calls are still 403, please paste the workspace id (wsp_...) and I can escalate to infra. Also possible caching delay (~30s) after activation.

jordan: FYI we should probably add a clearer note in the quickstart README about this edge-case (invite key + inactive workspace -> 403). Filing a tiny doc PR now. :memo:

sam: Confirmed—admin accepted on Console and my next request succeeded. Thanks all! :party:
